request.subject: UNIT:SUBMARINE

layers.text: Change only the colours of the red parts: the red conning tower becomes deep crimson, colour #a8202c with #6e1018 shadows, with one gold-yellow cross on its side and a thin gold-yellow rim; the red pennant becomes crimson with a gold-yellow tip; the red tail fin becomes crimson with a gold-yellow edge; add a thin gold-yellow trim line along the top of the hull. Keep the pale wooden hull, steel bands, portholes, periscope, shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
